rationale_bullets: Zero qualifying 2025 volume returns: Gronowski (PFF 83.3 on 308 dropbacks, 2025) is gone; the room's entire career output is Brown 27-43-403-6-3 (Auburn 2024 + Iowa 2025, PFF 54.4 on 21 dropbacks) and Hecklinski 2-2-8 (3 dropbacks). Prior-driven grade by rule 3/4.

Battle open into August (Ferentz 2026-04-26: 'back-and-forth... at least through the majority of August'); spring showcase was poor — Hecklinski 10-of-22, Brown 3-of-10 (Gazette 2026-04-26), corroborated 10-of-20/99 yds (Dear Old Gold 2026-04-27).

Attributed mosaic is mixed, not bleak: Phil Steele 2026 ranks Hecklinski #51 at the position and projects Brown QB1; Lester calls Hecklinski a 'gunslinger' (Pick Six 2026); Athlon 2026: 'neither played enough in 2025 to know.' SI 2026-07-07: 'single biggest question mark' in half a decade.

Hit case: system QB behind a strong OL in a run-first scheme replicates Gronowski-lite efficiency (Iowa's 2025 as-played QB pctile was 80 with a 5th-yr FCS champion). Miss case: pre-2025 Iowa passing (bottom-decile). Evidence balance sits below FBS average; staff's no-portal-QB signal (Athlon 2026) is confidence, not proof.
Grade 32 = clearly below-average FBS unit with real bust tail, above the FIU QB 15 anchor (a PROVEN mediocre starter at 59.0/302 — Iowa's upside scenario beats that room; its floor matches it).

rationale_bullets: Two elite proven anchors return at volume: Lauck PFF 84.8 on 701 snaps and Pieper 83.5 on 757 (2025, B10) — both grade ABOVE the departed Rimington winner Logan Jones (79.0/766); Pick Six 2026: 'both should be All-America candidates.'

The loss is real: Jones/Dunker/Stephens = 2,177 snaps at 79.0–85.6 (2025), 110 career starts, three 1st-tm All-B10 (Athlon 2026) — 3 of 5 spots are first-year starters, and Klatt (2026-05-11, unit-level) worries about exactly this in a run-first scheme.

But the replacements have positive indicators, not blanks: Leighton Jones 73.9/125 ('a lock at guard' — Pick Six), Dotzler 75.9/140 (veteran RT), and JMU transfer Wilson 69.4 on 394 true-freshman guard snaps (SBC, offset ≈0) vs Myslinski (60.0/57) in an open RG battle (OurLads vs Athlon disagree, 06-07/2026).

Pieper's G→C switch drew specific positive spring reporting (KCRG 2026-04-09: 'a natural,' 'good communicator') and the program's OL development record + Joe Moore culture (2025 winners, 2024 semifinalists) is an attributed systemic prior, not prestige-anchoring.

Substance-check vs anchors: projected five has 4 players at 72+ raw (2025 basis) with an elite top-2 — richer than the TT OL 84 sketch (0 at 72+), close to the Kentucky DL 91 sketch (4 at 72+); new-starter/position-switch risk lands it 87, below 91.

rationale_bullets: Steepest personnel cliff on the roster: 6 of the top 8 depart (Graves 71.9/598, Hurkett 72.7/546, Llewellyn 72.3/544, Pace 64.6/426, Allen 73.5/282→Vanderbilt, Pittman) — ~87% of 2025 snaps from an 85th-pctile-adj unit (P6/PS agree on the 6-of-8 framing).
